title: Provider capability sheet
description: One per provider (capabilities/<provider>.json). The adapter refuses a job the sheet rules out; the director writes in the sheet's syntax; the UI shows a control only when the routed provider's sheet allows it. Facts come from docs/production-tool/providers.md.

checked.description: When the facts were last checked against the provider's docs.

usdPerCredit.description: What one of the provider's credits costs in USD (Runway: 0.01, from guides/pricing.md and the OpenAPI info). Contract 3.

sources.description: The published documents the facts were checked against, with the date each was fetched. Their committed snapshots are in relay/tests/fixtures. Contract 3.

ops.description: Which ops this provider can run, and with which model. An op missing here is unsupported.

defaults.description: The settings one job of this op assumes when its request does not say (features/runway-sheet-sync.clan): what the relay reserves for and the cost model prices. The price itself comes from models[model].pricing through contracts/pricing.py. Replaced estimateUsd in contract 3.

durationsS.description: Allowed durations when the model takes only fixed values.

regionModel.description: clip_edit only: the model used when the edit carries a region (when it differs from the feel-edit model).

textEndpoint.description: clip only: where a clip with no first frame goes, made from words alone (a clip straight from the script; ui-behaviour 3.5). Absent: a clip needs its first frame. Added 2026-10-15 (additive).

seed.description: This op's model takes a seed. Overrides the sheet-level seed. Added 2026-10-06 (additive).

outputs.description: Allowed outputs per call for this op, e.g. [1, 4]. Added 2026-10-06 (additive).

label.description: The model's name in the regenerate menu ("Gemini 3 Pro"). Added 2026-10-08 (additive).

note.description: One line on what the model is good for, shown beside it in the menu. Added 2026-10-08 (additive).

tagSyntax.description: For this op's own model, replaces the sheet's (features/default-models.clan). Added 2026-10-08 (additive).

refs.description: For this op's own model, replaces the sheet's. Added 2026-10-08 (additive).

series.description: For this op's own model, replaces the sheet's. Added 2026-10-08 (additive).

outputsPerCall.description: For this op's own model, replaces the sheet's. Added 2026-10-08 (additive).

video.description: For this op's own model, replaces the sheet's. Added 2026-10-08 (additive).

alternates.description: Vetted models a participant may pick for this op when they regenerate (features/model-choice.clan). A pick runs on this provider with the alternate's fields over the op's, and its overrides over the sheet's. Only models the adapter builds a request for (its SUPPORTED list). Added 2026-10-08 (additive).

note.description: One line on what the model is good for, shown beside it in the menu. Never a price.

tagSyntax.description: Replaces the sheet's for this model.

refs.description: Replaces the sheet's for this model.

series.description: Replaces the sheet's for this model.

outputsPerCall.description: Replaces the sheet's for this model.

video.description: Replaces the sheet's for this model.

mode.description: clip_patch only: the alternate makes the window from its first and last frames (Veo 3.1 image_to_video) instead of editing the cut; it is priced by durationS, the window's billed seconds. Added 2026-10-14 (additive, features/clip-moment-edit.clan).

mask.description: Replaces the op's and the sheet's for this model.

preciseEdit.description: With no region and no mask, the op edits the whole image keeping its composition and size (ideogram_4_5 preciseEdit; providers.md fact 3). Added 2026-10-15 (additive, features/image-editor.clan).

mask.description: This op's model takes masks this way, over the sheet's mask (an op on a sheet whose other models take none: Runway's region_edit on ideogram_4_5). Added 2026-10-15 (additive, features/image-editor.clan).

preciseEdit.description: With no region and no mask, the op edits the whole image keeping its composition and size (ideogram_4_5 preciseEdit; providers.md fact 3). Added 2026-10-15 (additive, features/image-editor.clan).

method.description: resize and cutdown only (features/campaign-formats.clan): the Make all sizes method this model serves; the method table reads it, so a model change is data. crop, layout and reedit need no model. Added 2026-10-16 (additive).

models.description: The catalogue: every model an op uses or a planned feature needs, with its checked limits and its price (features/runway-sheet-sync.clan). Every op and alternate model is here; a model no op uses is allowed. Contract 3.

tagSyntax.description: How a prompt names references: at_tag '@hero' (Runway), none (refs by order only).

maxCharacter.description: Slots for character references (Runway subject human: 5).

mask.description: none: region edits go by the box drawn on a copy of the image plus our paste-back. Otherwise a PNG mask the size of the image, with the given colour marking the area to change.

angles.description: Turnaround by exact camera angle rather than by prompt.

series.description: Storyboard frames one call can return; 0 means one frame per call.

firstFrameWithRefs.description: Can pin the storyboard frame as the first frame AND pass the character views in the same call.

audioDefault.description: The provider's default. Adapters always set audio explicitly anyway.

audioControl.description: The clip model has an audio switch we can turn off. false: it always or never makes sound; the director adds 'no music, no dialogue'. Added 2026-10-06 (additive).

refsWithoutFrame.description: A clip with no first frame can carry reference pictures (text_to_video `references`): the character goes to the model as pictures, not words. Absent or false: a clip from words alone takes no pictures. Added 2026-10-15 (additive, features/runway-video-models.clan).

outputUrlTtlH.description: How long provider output URLs live; null when undocumented. We copy every output to S3 regardless.

cancel.description: The provider can cancel a running job. false: the UI hides Cancel and a cancelled job may still bill. Added 2026-10-06 (additive).

defaults.description: Settings for contracts/pricing.py. A field left out takes the model's default.

ratio.description: The output ratio; its resolution tier prices tiered models.

resolution.description: A resolution tier (512, 1K, 2K, 4K) or an upscaler's output resolution (720p, 1k, 2k, 4k).

refs.description: How many reference images the call carries.

durationS.description: Output length of a generated clip.

inputS.description: Length of the input video (an edit's output is as long as its input).

inputPx.description: The input image's longest side, for an upscale.

model.description: One model's checked facts, held to the provider's published schema and price list by relay/tests/test_runway_sheet.py.

maker.description: The company that makes the model and receives what a job sends it (features/tenant-limits.clan). An agency's allow.makers turns models on or off by maker; an unknown maker is off. 'napkin' is ours (the mock), which no allowlist turns off. Each maker's data terms are in contracts/subprocessors.json. Contract 3.

tier.description: The resolution tier the ratio's pixel count falls in: images 512, 1K, 2K, 4K; video 360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p, 4K (and an auto_<n>p ratio's own).

promptUnit.description: How promptMax is counted: UTF-16 code units, as Runway measures.

preciseEdit.description: Edits the first reference image keeping its composition and size.

firstLastFrame.description: Takes a first frame and an optional last frame (never a last frame alone).

audioParam.description: The model's request has an `audio` switch (the adapter sends it, always false today). false: no such field; the model makes sound or not on its own. Added 2026-10-15 (additive, features/runway-video-models.clan).

negativePrompt.description: The model's request takes `negativePrompt` (Veo). Added 2026-10-15 (additive, features/runway-video-models.clan).

imagesMax.description: The most pictures one clip request carries, keyframes and references together (Kling O3: 7). Added 2026-10-15 (additive, features/runway-video-models.clan).

keyframeRatio.description: With a first frame the request's ratio is auto_<tier> (WAN 3: the shape follows the frame), the tier of the ratio the job asked for. Added 2026-10-15 (additive, features/runway-video-models.clan).

v2v.description: How the model edits a clip on POST /v1/video_to_video, when it is offered for clip_edit. Added 2026-10-15 (additive, features/runway-video-models.clan).

videoField.description: The field that carries the clip.

mode.description: The `mode` sent (Omni Flash 1.1, Seedance 2.5: edit changes the clip in place).

durationAuto.description: Send duration "auto" (Seedance 2.5 edit keeps the clip's length).

refsMax.description: Reference pictures one edit may carry, besides the clip.

inputMaxS.description: The longest clip the edit takes.

audioParam.description: The edit's request has an `audio` switch (Seedance 2.5); sent explicitly, false today.

pricing.description: A model's price in credits (times usdPerCredit for USD), computed only by contracts/pricing.py and held to examples/pricing-cases.json.

unit.description: image: per output image (times outputs); second: per second of output (durationS, or inputS for an edit); frame: per output frame (fps times inputS).

audioCredits.description: Per unit when audio is on.

byResolution.description: Per unit by resolution tier: an image's tier (512, 1K, 2K, 4K), a video upscaler's output (720p, 1k, 2k, 4k), or a clip's tier per second (360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p, 4K; Hailuo 3's 768p, 2k), from settings.resolution or the tier of settings.ratio.

overPx.description: Above this output side in px the price is overPxCredits.

source.description: The provider's published price rows this was entered from, verbatim (relay/tests/fixtures/pricing).

perRef.description: Added per reference picture or keyframe the call carries (settings.refs), on top of the per-unit price (Hailuo 3: 2; Omni Flash 1.1: 1, an image-to-video start frame included). Added 2026-10-15 (additive, features/runway-video-models.clan).

perInputSecond.description: Added per second of input video (settings.inputS), on top of the output's price (Omni Flash 1.1 edit: 1). Added 2026-10-15 (additive, features/runway-video-models.clan).

perInputSecondByResolution.description: As perInputSecond, by the output's resolution tier (Seedance 2.5). Added 2026-10-15 (additive, features/runway-video-models.clan).
